newsitem.title: KENYA: Police say three people killed in Kenya unrest.
newsitem.headline: Police say three people killed in Kenya unrest.

text.p: Police said two policemen were killed on Friday and police shot and killed a man in clashes in Kenya's capital and the town of Kiambu during a one-day strike called by opposition groups.
A police statement said pro-reform demonstrators in Nairobi's Uhuru park hurt many people in scuffles and seriously injured an off-duty policeman who died on arrival at Kenyatta National Hospital.

Witnesses said youths chased and beat several people they accused of being police spies. Two people were lightly injured and one man, identified by demonstrators as a police inspector with the special branch, died of his injuries in an ambulance.
The police statement said a police inspector in the town of Kiambu, 10 km (six miles) north of Nairobi, was stoned by a mob that had barricaded a road and he was killed when his vehicle overturned.

It said police opened fire with teargas and then live ammunition when demonstrators barricaded a main road near Kiambu. One attacker was hit by a bullet in his left leg and died at Kiambu hospital while he was being treated, the statement said.
